package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	LearningPathPolicyVersion     = "student-learning-path-v1"
	LearningPathListSchemaVersion = "student-learning-path-list.v1"
	LearningContextSchemaVersion  = "student-learning-context.v1"
	DiagnosticPolicyVersion       = "student-diagnostic-snapshot-v1"
	LearningSessionVersion        = "student-learning-session-v1"
)

type LearningPathStatus string

const (
	LearningPathStatusActive    LearningPathStatus = "ACTIVE"
	LearningPathStatusPaused    LearningPathStatus = "PAUSED"
	LearningPathStatusCompleted LearningPathStatus = "COMPLETED"
	LearningPathStatusArchived  LearningPathStatus = "ARCHIVED"
)

type LearningPathItemStatus string

const (
	LearningPathItemPlanned         LearningPathItemStatus = "PLANNED"
	LearningPathItemReady           LearningPathItemStatus = "READY"
	LearningPathItemInProgress      LearningPathItemStatus = "IN_PROGRESS"
	LearningPathItemCompleted       LearningPathItemStatus = "COMPLETED"
	LearningPathItemSkippedMastered LearningPathItemStatus = "SKIPPED_MASTERED"
)

// StudentLearningPath is the current Student-owned route. Course identity
// and planning reason are supplied by Learning Planner, while Student owns storage,
// optimistic concurrency, and the immutable revision audit.
type StudentLearningPath struct {
	ID                   string             `json:"id"`
	StudentID            string             `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID             string             `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode             string             `json:"goal_code"`
	CurriculumRevision   string             `json:"curriculum_revision"`
	CourseFingerprint    string             `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PolicyVersion        string             `json:"policy_version"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion string             `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode           string             `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary        string             `json:"reason_summary"`
	Status               LearningPathStatus `json:"status"`
	IsPrimary            bool               `json:"is_primary"`
	IsSelected           bool               `json:"is_selected"`
	Version              int64              `json:"version"`
	Items                []LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
	CreatedAt            time.Time          `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt            time.Time          `json:"updated_at"`
}

type LearningPathItem struct {
	ID                 string                 `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	LessonRevisionID   string                 `json:"lesson_revision_id,omitempty"`
	FrozenRequirements []LessonRequirement    `json:"frozen_requirements,omitempty"`
	LessonContent      json.RawMessage        `json:"-"`
	ReferenceType      string                 `json:"reference_type"`
	ReferenceID        string                 `json:"reference_id"`
	Position           int                    `json:"position"`
	Status             LearningPathItemStatus `json:"status"`
	Targets            []LearningTargetRef    `json:"targets"`
	ReasonCode         string                 `json:"reason_code"`
}

func NormalizeStudentLearningPath(input StudentLearningPath) (StudentLearningPath, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeOnboardingCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.CurriculumRevision = strings.TrimSpace(input.CurriculumRevision)
	input.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseFingerprint)
	if input.CourseFingerprint == "" {
		input.CourseFingerprint = input.CurriculumRevision
	}
	if input.CurriculumRevision == "" {
		input.CurriculumRevision = input.CourseFingerprint
	}
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.PlannerPolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannerPolicyVersion)
	input.ReasonCode = normalizeOnboardingCode(input.ReasonCode)
	input.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonSummary)
	if input.Status == "" {
		input.Status = LearningPathStatusActive
	}
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(input.ID); err != nil || !validJourneyUUID(input.StudentID) || !validJourneyUUID(input.CourseID) ||
		input.GoalCode == "" || len(input.GoalCode) > 64 || input.CurriculumRevision == "" || len(input.CurriculumRevision) > 128 ||
		input.CourseFingerprint != input.CurriculumRevision ||
		input.PolicyVersion != LearningPathPolicyVersion || input.PlannerPolicyVersion == "" || len(input.PlannerPolicyVersion) > 64 ||
		input.ReasonCode == "" || len(input.ReasonCode) > 64 || !validLearningPathStatus(input.Status) ||
		(input.IsPrimary && input.Status != LearningPathStatusActive) ||
		input.ReasonSummary == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.ReasonSummary) > 500 || input.Version < 1 ||
		input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) || len(input.Items) < 1 || len(input.Items) > 500 {
		return StudentLearningPath{}, errors.New("invalid student learning path")
	}
	items := make([]LearningPathItem, len(input.Items))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Items))
	readyCount := 0
	for index, item := range input.Items {
		item.ReferenceType = normalizeOnboardingCode(item.ReferenceType)
		item.ReferenceID = strings.TrimSpace(item.ReferenceID)
		item.ReasonCode = normalizeOnboardingCode(item.ReasonCode)
		targets, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(item.Targets)
		if err != nil || (item.ReferenceType != "lesson" && item.ReferenceType != "practice") ||
			!validJourneyUUID(item.ReferenceID) || item.Position != index || !validPathItemStatus(item.Status) ||
			item.ReasonCode == "" || len(item.ReasonCode) > 64 {
			return StudentLearningPath{}, errors.New("invalid student learning path item")
		}
		if err := ValidateLessonAssignment(item); err != nil {
			return StudentLearningPath{}, err
		}
		if len(item.FrozenRequirements) == 0 {
			item.FrozenRequirements = nil
		}
		identity := learningPathItemIdentity(item)
		if _, exists := seen[identity]; exists {
			return StudentLearningPath{}, errors.New("duplicate student learning path item")
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		if item.Status == LearningPathItemReady {
			readyCount++
		}
		item.Targets = targets
		items[index] = item
	}
	if readyCount > 1 {
		return StudentLearningPath{}, errors.New("multiple ready learning path items")
	}
	input.Items = items
	return input, nil
}

func validLearningPathStatus(value LearningPathStatus) bool {
	switch value {
	case LearningPathStatusActive, LearningPathStatusPaused, LearningPathStatusCompleted, LearningPathStatusArchived:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// StudentLearningContext is the optimistic Student-owned selection and path-lifecycle
// aggregate. Version is the whole learner journey version, not a version local to
// the selected pointer. A zero version represents no persisted aggregate yet.
type StudentLearningContext struct {
	Schema                 string     `json:"schema"`
	StudentID              string     `json:"student_id"`
	SelectedLearningPathID string     `json:"selected_learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	Version                int64      `json:"version"`
	UpdatedAt              *time.Time `json:"updated_at,omitempty"`
}

func NormalizeStudentLearningContext(input StudentLearningContext) (StudentLearningContext, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.SelectedLearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SelectedLearningPathID)
	if input.Schema == "" {
		input.Schema = LearningContextSchemaVersion
	}
	if input.Schema != LearningContextSchemaVersion || !validJourneyUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!optionalJourneyUUID(input.SelectedLearningPathID) || input.Version < 0 {
		return StudentLearningContext{}, errors.New("invalid student learning context")
	}
	if input.Version == 0 {
		if input.SelectedLearningPathID != "" || input.UpdatedAt != nil {
			return StudentLearningContext{}, errors.New("invalid empty student learning context")
		}
		return input, nil
	}
	if input.UpdatedAt == nil || input.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
		return StudentLearningContext{}, errors.New("invalid student learning context version")
	}
	updatedAt := input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = &updatedAt
	return input, nil
}

type StudentLearningPathSummary struct {
	ID                 string             `json:"id"`
	CourseID           string             `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode           string             `json:"goal_code"`
	Status             LearningPathStatus `json:"status"`
	IsPrimary          bool               `json:"is_primary"`
	IsSelected         bool               `json:"is_selected"`
	Version            int64              `json:"version"`
	CompletedItemCount int                `json:"completed_item_count"`
	TotalItemCount     int                `json:"total_item_count"`
	CurrentItem        *LearningPathItem  `json:"current_item,omitempty"`
	UpdatedAt          time.Time          `json:"updated_at"`
}

type StudentLearningPathList struct {
	Schema         string                       `json:"schema"`
	StudentID      string                       `json:"student_id"`
	JourneyVersion int64                        `json:"journey_version"`
	Items          []StudentLearningPathSummary `json:"items"`
}

type StudentLearningPathMutation struct {
	Path    StudentLearningPath    `json:"path"`
	Context StudentLearningContext `json:"context"`
}

func SummarizeStudentLearningPath(path StudentLearningPath, selectedPathID string) (StudentLearningPathSummary, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentLearningPathSummary{}, err
	}
	summary := StudentLearningPathSummary{
		ID: normalized.ID, CourseID: normalized.CourseID, GoalCode: normalized.GoalCode,
		Status: normalized.Status, IsPrimary: normalized.IsPrimary,
		IsSelected: selectedPathID == normalized.ID, Version: normalized.Version,
		TotalItemCount: len(normalized.Items), UpdatedAt: normalized.UpdatedAt,
	}
	for index := range normalized.Items {
		item := normalized.Items[index]
		if item.Status == LearningPathItemCompleted || item.Status == LearningPathItemSkippedMastered {
			summary.CompletedItemCount++
		}
		if summary.CurrentItem == nil && (item.Status == LearningPathItemInProgress || item.Status == LearningPathItemReady) {
			copy := item
			summary.CurrentItem = &copy
		}
	}
	return summary, nil
}

func validPathItemStatus(value LearningPathItemStatus) bool {
	switch value {
	case LearningPathItemPlanned, LearningPathItemReady, LearningPathItemInProgress,
		LearningPathItemCompleted, LearningPathItemSkippedMastered:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// StudentDiagnosticSnapshot records a bounded distribution of current
// Student-owned mastery at a curriculum revision. UNKNOWN remains explicit.
type StudentDiagnosticSnapshot struct {
	ID                 string                   `json:"id"`
	StudentID          string                   `json:"student_id"`
	AssessmentID       string                   `json:"assessment_id"`
	CurriculumRevision string                   `json:"curriculum_revision"`
	PolicyVersion      string                   `json:"policy_version"`
	Items              []DiagnosticSnapshotItem `json:"items"`
	CompletedAt        time.Time                `json:"completed_at"`
}

type DiagnosticSnapshotItem struct {
	Target       LearningTargetRef  `json:"target"`
	State        TargetMasteryState `json:"state"`
	MasteryScore float64            `json:"mastery_score"`
	Confidence   float64            `json:"confidence"`
}

func NormalizeStudentDiagnosticSnapshot(input StudentDiagnosticSnapshot) (StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.AssessmentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AssessmentID)
	input.CurriculumRevision = strings.TrimSpace(input.CurriculumRevision)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.CompletedAt = input.CompletedAt.UTC()
	if !validJourneyUUID(input.ID) || !validJourneyUUID(input.StudentID) || !validJourneyUUID(input.AssessmentID) ||
		input.CurriculumRevision == "" || len(input.CurriculumRevision) > 128 ||
		input.PolicyVersion != DiagnosticPolicyVersion || input.CompletedAt.IsZero() || len(input.Items) < 1 || len(input.Items) > 500 {
		return StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid diagnostic snapshot")
	}
	items := make([]DiagnosticSnapshotItem, len(input.Items))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Items))
	for index, item := range input.Items {
		target, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(item.Target)
		identity := targetIdentity(target)
		if err != nil || !validDiagnosticMasteryState(item.State) || item.MasteryScore < 0 || item.MasteryScore > 1 ||
			item.Confidence < 0 || item.Confidence > 1 {
			return StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid diagnostic item")
		}
		if _, exists := seen[identity]; exists {
			return StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{}, errors.New("duplicate diagnostic item")
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		item.Target = target
		items[index] = item
	}
	input.Items = items
	return input, nil
}

func validDiagnosticMasteryState(value TargetMasteryState) bool {
	return value == TargetMasteryUnknown || validLearnerOverviewMasteryState(value)
}

type StudentLearningSession struct {
	ID                       string     `json:"id"`
	StudentID                string     `json:"student_id"`
	Goal                     string     `json:"goal"`
	CourseID                 string     `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	LessonID                 string     `json:"lesson_id,omitempty"`
	TaskID                   string     `json:"task_id,omitempty"`
	AnalyticsSessionID       string     `json:"analytics_session_id,omitempty"`
	ActiveLearningSeconds    int        `json:"active_learning_seconds"`
	LessonCount              int        `json:"lesson_count"`
	TaskCount                int        `json:"task_count"`
	QuestionCount            int        `json:"question_count"`
	SelectedExplanationCount int        `json:"selected_explanation_count"`
	CodeRunCount             int        `json:"code_run_count"`
	FailureCount             int        `json:"failure_count"`
	PassedTestCount          int        `json:"passed_test_count"`
	HintCount                int        `json:"hint_count"`
	TeacherInterventionCount int        `json:"teacher_intervention_count"`
	StuckSignalCount         int        `json:"stuck_signal_count"`
	Version                  int64      `json:"version"`
	SchemaVersion            string     `json:"schema_version"`
	StartedAt                time.Time  `json:"started_at"`
	EndedAt                  *time.Time `json:"ended_at,omitempty"`
	UpdatedAt                time.Time  `json:"updated_at"`
}

func NormalizeStudentLearningSession(input StudentLearningSession) (StudentLearningSession, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.Goal = strings.TrimSpace(input.Goal)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.LessonID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LessonID)
	input.TaskID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskID)
	input.AnalyticsSessionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AnalyticsSessionID)
	input.SchemaVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.SchemaVersion)
	input.StartedAt = input.StartedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	if !validJourneyUUID(input.ID) || !validJourneyUUID(input.StudentID) || input.Goal == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.Goal) > 300 ||
		!optionalJourneyUUID(input.CourseID) || !optionalJourneyUUID(input.LessonID) || !optionalJourneyUUID(input.TaskID) ||
		!optionalJourneyUUID(input.AnalyticsSessionID) || input.SchemaVersion != LearningSessionVersion || input.Version < 1 ||
		input.StartedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.StartedAt) || input.ActiveLearningSeconds < 0 ||
		input.LessonCount < 0 || input.TaskCount < 0 || input.QuestionCount < 0 || input.SelectedExplanationCount < 0 ||
		input.CodeRunCount < 0 || input.FailureCount < 0 || input.PassedTestCount < 0 || input.HintCount < 0 ||
		input.TeacherInterventionCount < 0 || input.StuckSignalCount < 0 {
		return StudentLearningSession{}, errors.New("invalid learning session")
	}
	if input.EndedAt != nil {
		ended := input.EndedAt.UTC()
		if ended.Before(input.StartedAt) || input.UpdatedAt.Before(ended) {
			return StudentLearningSession{}, errors.New("invalid learning session interval")
		}
		input.EndedAt = &ended
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validJourneyUUID(value string) bool {
	_, err := uuid.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(value))
	return err == nil
}

func optionalJourneyUUID(value string) bool { return value == "" || validJourneyUUID(value) }
